mapper.sql: select dequipmentmaintenanceday.id, dequipmentmaintenanceday.equipment_id, dequipmentmaintenanceday.part_name, dequipmentmaintenanceday.content, dequipmentmaintenanceday.maintenance_type, dequipmentmaintenanceday.is_external, dequipmentmaintenanceday.external_company, dequipmentmaintenanceday.plan_day, dequipmentmaintenanceday.true_day, dequipmentmaintenanceday.executor_id, dequipmentmaintenanceday.executor_name, dequipmentmaintenanceday.status, dequipmentmaintenanceday.remark, dequipmentmaintenanceday.create_by, dequipmentmaintenanceday.create_time, dequipmentmaintenanceday.update_by, dequipmentmaintenanceday.update_time, dequipmentmaintenanceday.dept_id, dequipmentmaintenanceday.dept_name, dequipmentmaintenanceday.del_flag,dequipmentmaintenanceday.equ_fault_lv,dequipmentmaintenanceday.day_no,dequipmentmaintenanceday.source,dequipmentmaintenanceday.price from d_equipment_maintenance_day dequipmentmaintenanceday
mapper.delete: update d_equipment_maintenance_day set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update d_equipment_maintenance_day set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS dayid, b.id, b.`name` AS equName, b.equ_no, c.nick_name AS userName, a.plan_day, a.status FROM d_equipment_maintenance_day a LEFT JOIN d_equipment b ON a.equipment_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON a.executor_id = c.user_id WHERE a.del_flag = 0 and a.`type` = #{type} and (a.plan_day = #{time} or a.plan_day is null) and a.executor_id = #{executorId}
